<!-- pr-reviewer: 134790d09e1e3fe4b0c6355cdfb8aac47fbde6da -->
**Ready for the maintainer to merge.**

Review under the safety floor (#2210 is P1). I did not accept the claims of the PR body. I checked them with a code trace and with my own probes against a part that has the turn baked into its mesh.

### What looks good

- The guard that the PR removes was a scope limit, not a defect guard. It came in with a40c158fe (#326): "Widening the verified kinds means wiring each kind's remaining world reads (selection walk, area controls, ...) through setup_align and pinning it, then dropping it from the refusal." #1858 kept it with no defect reason.
- Code trace of `operation/boundary_ctx.rs::build`: each area input reads the setup frame.
  - Picks (include, exclude, open boundary) go through `boundary_picks::picks_geom` -> `selection_geometry_in(world, setup, ...)`.
  - The part material, the silhouette and `pocket_ladder` go through `material::material_of` -> `setup_align::facets_in` / `entity_aabb_in`.
  - Model heights go through `heights::resolve_height` -> `setup_align::part_aabb_in`.
  - The open band (`open_band::lane` -> `stitch::gather_runs`) uses `OpFrame::pose_in_setup`.
  - The stock outline and the WCS are furniture (#326 "Only parts move"). That is correct.
  - The cache stamp hashes the alignment.
- The tilt refusal and the unverified-kind refusals stay in `generation_problem`.
- The new pinning suite `setup_align_2d_area` uses an L part turned 90 degrees about Z, so a wrong frame gives a different region. It compares against the baked part to 1e-6, compares the NC, and requires 0 gouge cells.
- The decision file `docs/decisions/2210-aligned-area-controls.md` is present. The body has `Changelog:`, `Effort: high` and `Fixes #2210`. The commit subject is conventional. There is no golden, snapshot, CHANGELOG or process file change, and no line-ending churn.

### Results (locally, PR head trial-merged with `origin/main` 59e7378b2, clean merge)

| Binary (camcraft-app) | Result |
|---|---|
| setup_align_2d_area (new) | 5 passed |
| opframe_picks | 4 passed |
| setup_align_3d | 6 passed |
| setup_align | 10 passed |
| area_controls | 13 passed |
| area_open | 11 passed |
| area_picks | 5 passed |
| area_chains | 4 passed |
| area_overhead | 1 passed |
| open_band | 7 passed |
| opframe_seam | 8 passed |
| align_axes / align_compose | 9 / 3 passed |
| plane_align / points_align / winding_align | 9 / 8 / 9 passed |
| `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings` | clean |

**Reviewer probes (scratch tests, not committed).** I used an L prism with `AlignPartToSetup::angles` at five poses: flip about X, flip about Y, 90 degrees about X, 90 degrees about Y, and 90 about X plus 90 about Z. Each case compares the aligned document with the same document where the stored alignment is baked into the mesh. The checks are: move count and kind, maximum deviation, equal posted NC, `simulate_document` gouge cells, and no blocking warning.

| Case | Result |
|---|---|
| Pocket, stock source, exclude a picked top face | match at 5 poses |
| 2D Adaptive, stock source, exclude a picked top face | match at 5 poses |
| Pocket, include silhouette, offset 2 | match at 5 poses |
| Face, selected face, offset 1 | match at 5 poses |
| Contour, selected face, offset 1 | match at 5 poses |
| Face, open chain, Inside and Outside | match at 5 poses |
| Contour, open chain, extension 3 | match at 5 poses |
| Pocket, stock source, open chain | match at 5 poses |
| Pocket, two parallel open chains as source, extension 2, offset 0.5 | match at 5 poses |
| 2D Adaptive, two parallel open chains as source, extension 2 | match at the two flip poses (17810 moves). The debug run is about 70 s for each generate, so the 90-degree poses ran out of my time box. |

All matches have a deviation of 0 or not more than 3.6e-15, equal NC and 0 gouge cells in the two documents.

**The issue's acceptance case (`testdata/models/fig8.camproj`, maintainer's checkout).** I loaded the project with `project::load` and generated `2D Adaptive1`:

- The generate succeeds: 6415 moves, 0 gouge cells. The refusal of #2210 is gone. That is the "Done means" of the issue.
- The post is blocked by 15 verify warnings:

```
post blocked - 15 warning(s): 2D Adaptive1: feed moves 1165 and 1167 cross in XY at shared depth; 2D Adaptive1: feed moves 1196 and 1198 cross in XY at shared depth; ...
```

- I made a copy with no part alignment and the same turn written into the part pose (baked). It gives the same 6415 moves and the same 15 crossings at the same move numbers. Thus the crossings do not come from this PR's frame wiring. They come from the 2D Adaptive generator on this geometry, and the verify gate refuses them visibly. This is not a blocker for this PR. But the maintainer will see "post blocked" as the next step on fig8. I recommend a follow-up issue (no open issue covers it; #2237 is the same symptom on 3D Pocket).

### Requested before merge

None.

### Questions / notes (not blocking)

1. `crates/app/tests/opframe_picks.rs`: the replaced assert accepts any generate error that does not contain "aligned setup". This is a weak positive check. The new `setup_align_2d_area` suite carries the real proof, so this is acceptable.
2. `crates/app/src/setup_align.rs` is now 406 lines. It was already over 400 before this PR. Only the doc comment grew.
3. The body names a known gap: `boundary_picks::extend_to_loop` reads face normals through `model::transform_of`, not the setup frame. For a flipped part it can seed a different face in the UI pick helper. It does not change a cut. A follow-up issue would keep it tracked.
4. Not exercised: the UI, the 2D Adaptive open-band source at the 90-degree poses (see above), and the tilt refusal beyond the author's tests (I read it in code).

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
